g.text: SHARE Digital Twin: System Architecture & Dual-Stream Pipeline
Cardiovascular Autonomic Baseline Modeling & Exploratory Event Prediction | PhysioNet SHAREE Cohort (N=139, 17 Confirmed Vascular Events; 12.2% Prevalence)
Not for clinical diagnostic, urgent care, or treatment use
Files excluded from intended public repository by .gitignore
*.gitignore exclusion policy for repo distribution; does not guarantee
privacy or imply audited publication history.
• Demographics: Age, Sex, Weight, Height, BSA, BMI, Smoker
• Morphology: IMT MAX, LVMI (g/m²), Ejection Fraction (EF%)
139 patient records × 12 clinical columns | Input to Static RF
24h Ambulatory Holter ECG (128 Hz, 3 Leads, QRS)
5 HRV Markers: HR (bpm), Mean RR (ms), SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50
• 8 stats per marker: Mean, Std, Min, Max, Median, First,
• Pre-generated demo patients: DEMO-001, DEMO-002, DEMO-003
• Zero overlap with PhysioNet SHAREE records; all labels=0
• Runs out-of-the-box from a clean clone without real data
• Calculates personalized median baseline across patient's 24h recording
• Avoids misclassifications from arbitrary population-level cutoffs
Resistant to Holter recording noise artifacts & ectopic beats
Computed across 5 markers: HR, Mean RR, SDNN, RMSSD, pNN50
• Measures mathematical deviation from personal diurnal median.
• Does not denote clinical severity or immediate cardiovascular risk.
• Evaluates hypothetical physiological state shifts interactively
• Strictly immutable baseline: Patient median is never altered
Preserves electrophysiological consistency upon heart rate shifts
✓ Instantly recomputes robust z-scores & state deviation
✓ Visualizes counterfactual stability deltas on UI radar
✗ Refuses fabricated clinical risk predictions or probabilities
✗ Non-causal: Does not simulate drug therapy or interventions
(Isolated from ML models; verified by 10/10 automated tests)
5-Fold Stratified Patient CV | Cohort N=139, 17 Events (12.2% Prevalence)
Mean Fold ROC-AUC: 0.699 ± 0.163 | AP vs. baseline prevalence: 0.259 vs 0.122
Pure 100% dynamic signal | Zero static weighting applied
Demographics, Blood Pressure, LVMI, Ejection Fraction
OOF ROC-AUC: 0.526 | OOF AP: 0.137 | Mean Fold: 0.561 ± 0.152
Static markers alone exhibit near-chance discriminative power
Feeds exclusively into the Optional Late Fusion Box below
Concatenated RF OOF ROC-AUC: 0.647 | OOF AP: 0.232 (Underperforms dynamic-only)
Mean Fold ROC-AUC: 0.689 ± 0.165 | AP vs baseline: 0.252 vs 0.122
• Why 80/20? Empirical engineering prior acknowledging that
dynamic HRV carries substantially higher predictive signal
• Non-Validation Notice: Weighting is an investigational heuristic
and is NOT clinically validated, guideline-endorsed, or FDA-cleared.
• Only activated when query ?mode=dual_stream is requested.
• Default predictions use NO static weighting (P_dynamic pure).
Outputs P_fusion → Activates Dual-Stream mode on Clinician Dashboard
• Derived purely from 42 dynamic HRV summary features
• Zero static weighting applied (No 80% weight implied)
• Output of Late Fusion Box: 0.80 × P_dynamic + 0.20 × P_static
• Verified OOF ROC-AUC: 0.655 | Displays both stream contributions
experiment_11_dashboard.py | Flask REST API & Web UI
Baseline demographics, blood pressure, BMI, LVMI, and ejection fraction
MAD-scaled robust z-score radar chart + multi-scale deviation meter
Time-series of 15-min windows, diurnal trends & anomalous epoch alerts
Gini & permutation rankings (SDNN change, RMSSD max, Mean RR)
Interactive perturbation sliders (HR, SDNN, RMSSD) with live recomputation
• Prominently surfaces 17/139 event imbalance warning across tabs
• Explains that Twin Deviation is an engineering stability score
• Discloses absence of external cohort validation
• In demo mode without .joblib: displays labeled placeholder UI scores
• Explicitly disclaims medical device status or clinical diagnostic use
PhysioNet SHAREE Database DOI: 10.13026/C2RC7C | Melillo et al. PLoS ONE (2015) | Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By v1.0).
Architecture specification for Happiest Health Digital Twin Challenge 2026. Research prototype only — not validated for clinical care.
